speaker: ZCode
notes: 改进 Windows 上找会话的办法；从手机操作 Windows 上的会话在实测通过前暂不开放，设置 → 插件中有说明。
notesEn: Better session detection on Windows; controlling Windows sessions from your phone stays off until tested, as noted in Settings → Plugins.

gaps.text: Windows 上的查看还没实测（找进程的办法换成了 Windows 也能用的）
gaps.textEn: Viewing on Windows isn't tested yet (process detection now works on Windows too)

gaps.text: 回复、确认、回答提问、中断都做不到：ZCode 没有对外的操作接口，桌面版自带的命令行也没有可操作的终端界面
gaps.textEn: Replying, confirming, answering questions and interrupting aren't possible: ZCode offers no external control interface, and the CLI bundled with the desktop app has no interactive terminal interface

gaps.text: Mac、Windows 上还没实测（Linux 上已实测）
gaps.textEn: Not yet tested on Mac or Windows (tested on Linux)
